description: Paint tiles onto a map. Takes a list of operations applied in order: `cells` (individual positions), `rect` (filled or hollow rectangle) and `fill` (flood fill from a cell). Tiles are chosen as {sheet:'A2', kind:N} (autotile sheets A1-A4), {sheet:'B', index:N} (A5/B-E) or a raw tile id; 0 erases. Autotile edge, corner and wall shapes are calculated automatically, including re-shaping neighbours, just like painting in the editor. Layers: 0-1 ground, 2-3 upper tiles, 4 shadows, 5 regions. Typical map: fill layer 0 with a ground kind from A2, then place water/walls/objects on top. Use get_tileset_info / get_tileset_image to pick tiles and render_map to check the result.

layer.description: Map layer: 0-1 ground tiles, 2-3 upper tiles, 4 shadow bits (0-15), 5 region id (0-255). Defaults to 0 for sheets A1-A5 and 2 for B-E; required when erasing.

index.description: Tile index, for sheets A5 (0-127) and B-E (0-255)

kind.description: Autotile kind, for sheets A1-A4 (A1 0-15, A2 16-47, A3 48-79, A4 80-127)

tile.description: Which tile to place. Either {sheet, kind} for autotile sheets A1-A4, {sheet, index} for A5/B/C/D/E, or a raw tile id (0 erases). Autotile edge shapes are computed automatically.

hollow.description: Only paint the outline of the rectangle

name: paint_tiles
title: Paint map tiles
